notes.title: All Soundtracks Leaving Steam Store!
notes.content:
[p]All Soundtracks for this application will be leaving Steam Store. All songs will be available with the stand alone application and the website only. Final sales will be Sep 22 - 29 and the Autumn Sale right after. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Get FREE Access Key Code (Online Fan Community)[/b][/h3][p]Instructions on how to claim your FREE Gift:[/p][p]
To claim your gift, you simply need to own a copy of [b]Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life[/b] in your game inventory (the mouse icon will appear next to your name).

Post in this thread "gift me" and we will send you an access code (to register for free on [/p][p][url="https://www.foreverepicstory.com"]www.foreverepicstory.com[/url]) as a gift courtesy of Forever Epic Story *We will message you with the key.

What you receive with access:

1. Access to the full browser based online app.
2. Access to the community. Post shout outs, chat with the artists and engage in community activities.
3. Download songs from the album (MP3 format)

Register here and include your access code: [/p][p][url="https://www.foreverepicstory.com/signup"]https://www.foreverepicstory.com/signup[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.content:
